question: What analytical techniques are used to monitor reaction progress and characterize synthesized compounds in fluorodesulfurization reactions?
answer: In fluorodesulfurization reactions, reaction progress and synthesized compounds are monitored and characterized using thin-layer chromatography (TLC) with UV visualization, melting point analysis, and mass spectrometry (LC/MSD Trap XCT, GC-MS, and high-resolution Q-TOF LC/MS). Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy (¹H, ¹⁹F, and ¹³C at 400, 376, and 100 MHz, respectively) further confirms structural details, with CDCl₃ or DMSO-d₆ as solvents and TMS as the internal standard. These techniques ensure precise tracking of transformations and compound identification.
